researchQuestion: Can one low-cost independent LLM judge reproduce the existing human assessment of frozen RAG answers well enough to support later automatic evaluation?
hypothesis: GPT-5.4 Nano at medium reasoning will meet all agreement thresholds on both the calibration and held-out audit subsets while producing valid structured outputs for every item.

inputs.deduplication: Identical unanswerable task inputs are judged once and reused across the three blinded generator rows.

splitPolicy.calibrationRole: Measure agreement and diagnose the frozen judge; no audit labels may be used to edit prompt v1 or thresholds.
splitPolicy.auditRole: One-time held-out validation audit after prompt v1 and acceptance criteria are frozen.

primaryMetrics.pooledCoreQuadraticWeightedKappa: Flatten groundedness, key-fact coverage, citation correctness, and citation completeness over answerable rows; score range 0-4.
primaryMetrics.answerableQualitySpearman: Spearman correlation between human and judge normalized four-dimension quality over answerable rows.
primaryMetrics.binaryPassAgreement: Exact agreement under the frozen answer-level pass rule over all rows.

passRule.answerable: All four core scores are at least 3 and every binary failure flag is 0.
passRule.unanswerable: correctAbstention is 1 and every binary failure flag is 0.

diagnostics: Per-dimension QWK, MAE, exact agreement, and within-one agreement
Provider model, provider, finish reason, latency, token usage, cache hits, and cost
Every pass mismatch, score delta of at least two, or flag mismatch
A deterministic random sample of six audit agreements for secondary human review

decisionPolicy.pass: Freeze GPT-5.4 Nano and prompt v1 for later automatic evaluation, subject to secondary human disagreement audit.
decisionPolicy.fail: Do not silently change models or prompt. Document the failure; any prompt v2 or GPT-5.4 Mini attempt must be separately preregistered and may use calibration labels only.
decisionPolicy.testPolicy: Do not use the locked 24-case generation test until judge selection and disagreement audit are complete.

limitations: The human reference was produced quickly by one reviewer, so it is not ground truth and has no inter-rater reliability estimate.
Kappa and correlation may be unstable when human scores have low variance.
Repeated deterministic abstentions count as separate generator rows in agreement metrics but use one deduplicated judge request.
Provider availability, routing labels, and prices can change.
